brief: I think it might be worth looking at the actual game as well when you come up with these chapter images. The boat in hte sea concept art doesn't look quite the same as the boat in game, and the sky mirror one i think you can do a lot better to capture the feeling of that level i.e. the stars are points of bright light trapped under the mirror, not 5 sided things. See if you can come up with a better composition for the sky mirror one as well.

prompts.sea:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a finished 16:9 landscape chapter painting for Updraft, THE OPEN SEA, using actual game captures to preserve the boat's identity.
Image 1 is the authoritative boat geometry reference (daylight lighting was used to see its shape); image 2 shows the same boat's broad sail and the chapter's cool open-sea atmosphere; image 3 is ONLY the established chapter painting's smooth stylized rendering quality. Do not reproduce characters, the island, village, or the sunset composition.
Composition: a high oblique three-quarter BOW/SIDE view of the little boat travelling diagonally toward the LOWER LEFT through an immense expanse of blue water. No horizon or sky anywhere in the frame. Place the boat near the centre, hull around 56% down, mast top around 20% down, full hull roughly 27% of image width. The boat and full mast must remain visible through a wide crop. The wake streams behind it toward the upper right, a soft delicate curve.
Match the actual boat in reference 1 closely: a short, cute, rounded clinker dinghy, six BROAD warm wooden strakes, a deep round belly sitting properly IN the sea; distinctive thick WHITE RAKED BOW POST carrying the little brass lantern at its TOP, rising above the bow's small triangular wooden foredeck; cream rubbing rail running round the hull just below its wooden top edge; two loose cream rope swags along the visible side; open wooden interior with broad thwarts, floorboards, a small grey pail and coil of rope near the stern. The stern is a small flat wooden transom with cream rudder. The mast is stout dark brown, approximately central, with a small red pennant and simple boom.
The brick-red SCARF SAIL is a tapered QUADRILATERAL: narrow straight top, broad straight boom at bottom, gently bowed outer edge. It spreads behind the mast toward the stern, clearly visible from this chosen side, not edge-on. Paint soft broad folds and gentle fullness only, without knitting stitches or photographic fabric texture. No triangular yacht jib, no extra sails, no elaborate rigging, no invented boat fittings.
Quiet freedom and an easy breeze after night. Clear muted teal-blue and deep slate-blue sea, very broad LOW soft swells, gentle pale morning light from upper left on the boat's wood and a few long broken glints across the water. No steep waves, breaking crests, whitecaps or storm drama. Show the boat bobbing securely in the water, with a thin soft contact edge, not perched on top of it. Preserve open calm darker water in the lower centre for separately added UI.
Rendering: polished luminous animated-film environment painting matching reference3 in softness and controlled contrast, simplified tactile forms, dimensional light, clean continuous painted surfaces. No photo water microdetail, uniform ripple stamps, repeated diamond/diagonal swatches, facets, grain, canvas or paper texture. No people, animals, land, additional boats, letters, typography or UI.
prompts.mirror:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create an evocative finished 16:9 landscape chapter painting for Updraft, THE SKY MIRROR. Completely rethink the earlier still-life composition around the experience of finding fallen light under a mirror of the sky.
Image1 is an actual game capture: authoritative for the vast seamless mirror, lavender/rose reflected sky, ordinary small stool and enamel bowl, and the bright LIGHT POINTS on the surface. Image2 shows the actual clear soap bubble and its fine iridescent rim. Image3 is ONLY the approved chapter paintings' smooth luminous rendering style, not its objects or sunset layout. Do not include the child, bird, paper plane or other characters from the captures.
Camera and composition: look diagonally DOWN across the seamless mirror, with NO horizon in the frame. Almost the entire image is a beautiful reflection of a great lilac-blue sky and a few broad peach-lit cloud forms, arranged to sweep diagonally into the distance. These are reflections UNDER a smooth surface, never solid clouds sitting on water. The scene feels spacious, suspended and almost weightless.
Main subject: at about 57% across and 56% down is ONE intensely luminous tiny white-gold POINT OF LIGHT, trapped just beneath the transparent mirror skin. It is pure light with a small brilliant core, a warm diffuse halo and very fine soft tapering flare rays, foreshortened along the surface. It has NO solid outline, no polygon, no five-sided star, no jewel, no starfish, no physical star shape. The reflection of a cloud passes delicately across the glow to make the light feel underneath. One or two very faint elliptical rings clarify the otherwise invisible surface.
A single large, exquisitely delicate soap bubble floats very low just above and slightly behind/right of that light, its lower rim almost kissing the mirror. It is nearly invisible inside, with the reflected sky seen through it and only a fine pearl/rose/blue iridescent rim and one soft glint. The bubble and its correctly aligned reflection form an elegant paired-circle shape, the compositional focal point. No light inside this bubble yet: it is about to catch the trapped light. Scale the bubble to about 17% of frame width so its outline is legible at chapter-tile size, keeping its top within the central crop. The nearby bright light is a tiny point, not a huge sun or energy portal.
Two or three much smaller dimmer light pinpoints sit under the mirror further away, irregularly spaced, guiding the eye back across the expanse. No decorative sparkle field.
Supporting context well back at upper left, around 29% across and 31% down: the game's small simple ROUND THREE-LEGGED wooden stool carrying a SHALLOW blue-grey enamel soap bowl, with a thin round brass hoop and short all-brass handle resting against it. These props and their reflection occupy only about 15% of the width: part of the mysterious place, not a product still life. The legs touch the thin water with no island or platform. If any far jetty is visible, it must be tiny and incidental, never a boat silhouette.
Use pearly cool violet, muted blue and a little blush/apricot cloud light. The bright trapped light is the warm focal accent. Darker lavender foreground naturally quiet enough for separately added UI near the lower centre; no obvious blank panel or imposed vignette.
Style: smooth luminous stylized animated-film painting, dimensional soft clouds, clean softly rounded props, accurate restrained reflections, calm dreamlike space, the finish of reference3. NO patchwork brush shading, regular swatches, diamond facets, canvas/paper grain or repeating marks. No water waves, land, mountains, islands, solid clouds on water, boat, sun disc, moon, characters, animals, text or UI. Render a complete beautiful new composition.

finalPrompts.sea:

Keep this Updraft Open Sea chapter painting exactly in its current style, colours and boat identity. The boat now matches the game: round broad-straked wooden hull, prominent white raked bow post and lantern, cream rail and rope swags, triangular foredeck, benches, central stout mast, red four-sided scarf sail.
Make ONE composition correction for the chapter's widescreen crop: make the entire boat and rig together 14% smaller in the image, scaling around the centre of the complete vessel. Keep the hull, mast, sail and all parts in exactly the same proportions to each other. The top of the mast should land about 17–18% down the full image, the bottom of the hull around 72%, and the boat stay near the horizontal centre. Do not shrink the hull without the rig, shorten the mast, or otherwise redesign the boat. Naturally reconnect the wake to the slightly smaller stern and preserve the water's lovely broad gentle swell and clean surfaces.
Leave a generous area of blue water above the mast and below the hull so a 2.4:1 central crop contains the complete vessel. All other things remain unchanged, including the three-quarter bow view, cool blue sea, morning glints upper left, gentle curved wake upper right, character-free composition, soft broad sail folds without knit texture and clean painting finish. No text, new subjects or repeating swatches.
finalPrompts.mirror:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine this Sky Mirror chapter painting without changing its successful new composition: a view down across sky reflected underfoot, a low soap bubble and trapped point of light as the main subject, small stool with bowl and hoop at upper left.
The main correction is the foreground light. Currently its white core resembles a small white ball ON the surface. Change it to a tiny intense luminous PINPOINT just BENEATH the mirror skin: reduce the hard white central disc to one third its current diameter, remove any physical edge, keep a subtle soft white-gold halo and fine gently fading horizontal flare. Reflected lavender and peach cloud colour must pass continuously across its location, with the light shining through it from below. No object, ball, diamond, polygon or literal star shape. The three distant lights also remain fine points of light beneath the reflection.
Preserve the bubble's placement and delicately transparent centre, but make its rainbow rim a little thinner and quieter, with a few concentrated pearl glints rather than a thick glowing ring. Keep the correct reflection underneath. Its lower rim nearly touches the surface; the bubble is about to catch the light, not filled yet.
Simplify the reflected cloud field: use fewer larger SOFT cohesive cloud forms with much less tiny scumbled edge detail. Ease back the very bright orange cloud streak directly behind the bubble and leave more cool lilac-blue reflected sky around the main light and bubble, making a quiet place to look. Retain warm peach cloud highlights in other parts and the polished dimensional chapter-art finish, without flattening the overall richness. The mirror should feel perfectly smooth, almost invisible, immense and still. Only one faint elliptical ring around the trapped light; no waves or texture.
Keep the exact prop identities, proportions, general placements, composition and aspect ratio. The little brass hoop still needs a short brass handle resting against the stool, not a bare closed loop. No extra props or characters, no boat, land, horizon, actual clouds resting on the surface, sun, moon, text, repetitive marks, facets, grid, grain or canvas texture.
